title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description:
Overview

Department: Technical & Infrastructure

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards.

The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly overseeing the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding and non-competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums.

Key Responsibilities

  • Overseeing the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament.
  • Collaborating with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensuring that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums.
  • Working closely with the Non-Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project.
  • Being the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department.
  • Oversight of contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Constant monitoring of the budgetary impact of dressing operations and reporting updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly.
  • Providing strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offering expertise when required.
  • Adhering to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department.
  • Daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project.
  • Liaising with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans.
  • Presenting to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required.
  • Attending department-specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites.
  • Inputting into the site-specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management.
  • Acting as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project.
  • Participating in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites.
  • Assisting with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required.
  • Ensuring the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites.
  • Contribution to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities.
  • Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods.

Your Profile

  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities.
  • A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.).
  • Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large-scale temporary installations.
  • Budget management experience on complex and multi-faceted events and projects.
  • Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events.
  • Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events.
  • Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential.
  • The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

As an integral part of the Department of Dermatology, the Administrative Coordinator provides a range of administrative support to the Department Chair and multiple faculty in the Department of Dermatology at Howard University. Responsibilities include assisting with daily administrative operations, coordinating and scheduling complex appointments and meetings, coordinating travel and preparing associated materials, preparing correspondence, compiling data, coordinating special projects and events, and records maintenance. This position will be responsible for monitoring departmental academic and research budgets and business affairs, personnel matters and interpreting policy and procedures. The position will perform duties of a sensitive and confidential nature. Incumbents typically work at a high degree of independence with general direction and supervision received from the Department Chair.

Supervisory Accountability

Responsible for orienting and training other administrative hires, as needed in the future. May also be responsible for acting in a “lead” or “senior” capacity over clerical positions performing essentially the same work, or related technical tasks.

Nature And Scope

The principal duties and responsibilities of the Administrative Coordinator include, but are not limited to: Compose and prepare correspondence as well as assist in writing and preparation of manuscripts, grants, questionnaires, journal reviews, presentations, reports, letters, and memos for the Chair’s review and signature. Read email and coordinate office communications ensuring timeliness and accuracy. Screen and provide telephone coverage for the Chair, Faculty, and administrative offices. Represent the Chair in meetings, take dictation, minutes, notes and prepare final copy for review and arrange department meetings. Create graphic brochures, posters, signs, labels for conferences, newsletters, invitations and presentation slides for the department. Assist the Chair with activities relating to the University/College of Medicine, the Faculty Practice Plan (FPP), and the Hospital (HUH) (see below). Assist the Chair in the preparation of all faculty appointment, promotion and tenure applications and performance evaluations (e.g. OPPE). Assist with departmental development/philanthropic projects and continuing medical education (CME) conferences.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist and submit Attending Physicians OPPE and FPPE.
  • Coordinate Attending Physicians and staff work requests for facility maintenance or housekeeping.

  • Track and report KPIs related to aviation and logistics operations.

Education

  • Bachelor3s degree preferably in Business Administration or related areas;

Experience

  • Previous experience in a similar position.
  • Previous work in a multinational oil company is desirable.
  • Experience with crew logistics management, including scheduling, mobilizations, travel arrangements, accommodation, and documentation workflows.
  • Hands-on experience with logistics operations, such as travel bookings, vendor coordination, cost control, and operational support.
  • Experience using travel management systems and tools related to personnel logistics.

Oowlish, one of Latin America's rapidly expanding software development companies, is seeking experienced technology professionals to enhance our diverse and vibrant team.   • Implement authentication, authorization, and security best practices
  • Optimize application performance across web and mobile
  • Contribute to architectural decisions and code quality standards

Must Have

  • 5+ years of professional software development experience
  • Strong full-stack engineering skills
  • Experience with React, TypeScript, and modern JS frameworks
  • Hands-on experience with React Native / Expo
  • Familiarity with SQL databases and ORM tools
  • Understanding of cloud services and deployment strategies
  • Ability to design scalable systems and make sound technical decisions
  • Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
  • Self-starter capable of working independently across the stack

Nice to Have

  • Experience with authentication systems (Better Auth, SSO)

  • Exposure to CI/CD and deployment automation

Benefits & Perks

Home office; Competitive compensation based on experience; Career plans to allow for extensive growth in the company; International Projects; Oowlish English Program (Technical and Conversational); Oowlish Fitness with Total Pass; Games and Competitions;

title: Legacy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Reporting to Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, the FWWC2027 Legacy Manager, under the guidance of the Executive Director of Legacy and Stakeholder Affairs, will oversee all matters related to the development, implementation and reporting of the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme in close collaboration and with strategic guidance from the Women’s Football Division in FIFA.

Key responsibilities

  • Oversee and implement the FWWC 2027 Legacy Programme with the objective of delivering together with all relevant stakeholders a coordinated, long-lasting and tangible impact on the host country and region after hosting the event.
  • Coordinate the legacy activities of the CBF, FIFA and any other stakeholders related to the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027.
  • Bring to life the FWWC 2027 legacy framework consisting of three core pillars:
  1. Women’s Football Legacy: work with CBF, host cities and relevant stakeholders to build a positive legacy on the women’s football landscape in Brazil and the region.
  2. Social Impact Legacy: work with CBF, the Brazilian Federal Government, State Governments, NGO’s and other relevant stakeholders to identify, build and implement a lasting social impact leveraging the FWWC 2027 with a particular focus on gender-based violence and improving the position of women in Brazilian society.
  3. Infrastructure Legacy: work with relevant stakeholders to develop, record and report on infrastructure legacy opportunities and projects that have arisen due to hosting of the FWWC 2027.
  • Prepare and finalise a report to be released post-tournament which outlines the tangible impacts of the FWWC Legacy Programme including measures of both qualitative and quantitative impact.
  • Support the Women’s Football Division on any other matters related to the FWWC 2027 Legacy programme as and when required.

Your profile

  • Experience in Major Sports Events and Brazilian based organisations: Experience in a similar role within a Brazilian based organisation, with a clear track record of developing and implementing Legacy programmes and activities linked to major sporting events.
  • Legacy Development
  • Proven track record of developing and implementing legacy strategies.
  • Experience in Project Management including planning, organizing, and delivering complex projects and campaigns.
  • Experience in delivering post-event reporting.
  • Communication & Stakeholder Relations:
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to liaise with high-level stakeholders, including government officials, commercial partners and media (when necessary).
  • Experience in managing relationships with diverse international stakeholders, including commercial partners, local authorities, and FIFA officials.
  • Cultural Competency & Multinational Experience:
  • Experience working in multinational environments and understanding cultural nuances when coordinating across countries.
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Brazilian).
  • Right to work in Brazil and ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Partnership Development Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Overview

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The position

The Partnership Development Manager will be responsible for driving sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets. The role requires deep market knowledge and a robust network in the region.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Senior Partnership Development Manager, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Identify and pursue high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Source, qualify, and engage potential sponsors, securing meetings and presenting tailored partnership proposals to major regional and international brands.
  • Develop bespoke sponsorship packages that address the unique needs and objectives of prospective partners.
  • Lead negotiations through to successful acquisition, ensuring alignment with FIFA’s commercial guidelines and values.
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Establish and nurture long-term relationships with key sponsor prospects, ensuring continuity and value beyond the tournament.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for the FIFA27 team in Brazil on sales-related matters, supporting or managing the sales process as needed.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Build strong external visibility for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ commercial opportunities, fostering inbound interest and leads through proactive industry engagement.
  • Lead and support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Strong presenter and excellent relationship building skills.
  • Proven experience in sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Strong network and understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Experience in dealing with and negotiating within different cultures.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Sales CRM tools
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

title: Sales Analyst FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

The Sales Analyst will support the sponsorship sales team with research, analysis and data on potential sponsors. She/He will be responsible for generating research reports, data sets, market/category/brand specific insights and sales materials as well as the management of the Business Development Directory.

She/He will also be responsible for supporting the sales team in building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies. A key role in supporting sponsorship sales and strategic partnerships for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, with a strong focus on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.

The role requires deep market knowledge, a robust network in the region, and the ability to communicate fluently in English and Portuguese. Spanish is considered a plus.

Key responsibilities

  • Work closely with the Head of Partnership Sales, FIFA Women’s World Cup Sales Lead and the broader commercial team to deliver on sponsorship sales objectives for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, with a strong emphasis on the Brazilian and LATAM markets.
  • Work closely with the Partnership Sales team to deliver sponsorship and sales objectives, identifying and pursuing high-value sponsorship leads aligned with the commercial strategy of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Support the sales team research function, building compelling sales presentations utilising a range of internal and external data and partner case-studies.
  • Conduct in-depth desk and internet research.
  • Produce a range of materials (in collaboration with creative team) to support the sales managers throughout commercial discussions.
  • Become primary liaison with external suppliers and various internal research departments.
  • Support the sales team in sourcing, qualifying, and engaging potential sponsors, supporting generating tailored partnership proposals for major regional and international brands.
  • Ensure timely and accurate update and management of the CRM system for the FWWC27 Commercial team
  • Collaborate with the Strategy and Planning team to identify market opportunities and build compelling sales arguments.
  • Stay informed on emerging sponsorship categories, regional industry trends, and relevant market research, including pricing and inventory benchmarks.
  • Support the organisation of commercial events, conferences, hosting programmes, dedicated to cultivating business relationships and building into the sales pipeline.

Your profile

  • Highly professional, articulate and results-driven.
  • Proven experience in similar roles within sponsorship sales, business development, or commercial partnerships, preferably in sports or entertainment.
  • Experience using consumer insights platforms (ex. GlobalWebIndex)
  • Exposure to media value reports and how they’re used in sponsorship
  • Familiarity with market research platforms and broader sponsorship market
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian and LATAM commercial landscape.
  • Ability to work independently in a multi-task position within a dynamic, team-based environment.
  • Solutions orientated.
  • Solid time management and organizational skills.
  • Internal client oriented, efficient and effective.
  • Adept at handling and protecting confidential information.
  • Excellent team player and relationship builder.
  • Attention to detail, reliable and responsible.
  • An appreciation of the international sports federation environment, passion for women’s sports and global events.
  • University degree in business, sports marketing or related area
  • Excellent in Word / PowerPoint / Excel / PDF / MS Teams / Salesforce and other CRM tools
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, any other FIFA language (Spanish especially) is an advantage
  • Ability to travel often and when required.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

The position

This role will ensure the seamless planning and execution of supply chain operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ tournament. Will be responsible for material planning, operations planning, procedures and liaison with other Functional areas.

  • Logistics Planning: Design and implement end-to-end supply chain strategies for host city venues.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Overview

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we\'ve created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We\'re building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.

As we expand, we\'re scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.

About The Role

We\'re looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly\'s voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.

You\'ll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you\'ll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly\'s long-term growth trajectory.

  • Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Cambly\'s SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.
  • Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.
  • Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.
  • Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.
  • Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.
  • Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.
  • Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.
  • Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels
  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs
  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)
  • Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)
  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale
  • Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights
  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
  • Native in Portuguese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

title: Senior Regulatory Analyst
description:
Overview

The Senior Regulatory Analyst will be responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance for offshore operations and projects, defining deliverable scopes and deadlines, and supporting engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations teams. This role coordinates regulatory requirements, consolidates technical documentation, assesses compliance risks, supports audits and inspections, and implements action plans to address findings. The role contributes directly to maintaining operational licenses, preventing non-compliance, avoiding fines or interdictions, and ensuring alignment with internal schedules, budgets and applicable Brazilian authorities' requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Define the scope and deadlines for deliverables that sustain compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, observing production schedules and budgets
  • Support the definition of responsibilities and resources to achieve regulatory compliance efficiently, observing the BWE organization charts and budgets
  • Incorporate lessons learned to BWE, set action plans to prevent or address audit findings, notifications, and conditions to operate imposed by the Authorities
  • Collaborate with engineering, sustainability, safety, project management, and operations to ensure awareness of regulatory requirements, build compliance, and fulfill BWE schedules
  • Ensure that compliance-related tasks are executed efficiently, facilitating licenses and approvals, as well as preventing fines and interdictions
  • Consolidate engineering document lists, including all tech safety studies that are required to grant and sustain licenses and approvals needed to operate
  • Assess the content of engineering, tech safety, and other management system documents to provide proper support and guidance to achieve compliance
  • Follow up on specific discussions and execution wherever assigned to ensure proper incorporation of regulatory compliance requirements and related risk
  • Support activities to implement BWE strategy and scope for internal regulatory compliance self-assessment, inspections, and audits to prevent project schedule delays, interdictions and fines
  • Track, manage, and ensure proper closure and documentation of regulatory-related action items
  • Perform and/or guide inspections and audits of BWE facilities to assess and ensure proper compliance with regulatory and statutory requirements
  • Organize and coordinate internal preparations for regulatory audits
  • Flag to the Regulatory and Institutional Affairs Manager always when a potential critical non-conformance is identified or delays in regulatory compliance may delay schedules or not follow the original budgets
  • Support all other regulatory-related activities when required

Education

  • Engineering degree

Experience

  • Experience with regulatory requirements applied to offshore platforms
  • Experience fulfilling requirements for ANP shipyard audits
  • Experience responding to ANP conditions to operate
  • Knowledge of Class, Flag, and Navy requirements

Knowledge

  • Good understanding and knowledge of Offshore systems
  • Familiar with engineering/industry standards such as API, ASME, ASTM, NACE etc
  • Advanced English

description:
(Banco de Talentos) Analista Comercial - Inside Sales (Outbound) - Vaga Exclusiva para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) | Presencial/RJ

Rio De Janeiro, Rio De Janeiro, Brasil

Somos muito mais do que uma empresa de maquininhas! A Stone é uma empresa de tecnologia e serviços financeiros focada no(a) cliente.

Nascemos com o propósito de ser protagonistas na transformação da indústria de pagamentos, servindo o(a) empreendedor(a) brasileiro(a) e transformando seus sonhos em resultados.

Somos a maior empresa independente de meios de pagamentos do Brasil, com mais de quinze mil pessoas espalhadas pelas cinco regiões do país, em um cenário repleto de desafios e oportunidades. Valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a flexibilidade, o desenvolvimento contínuo e os pensamentos disruptivos e incansáveis na busca de soluções para a nossa RAZÃO.

A nossa cultura se manifesta em cada encontro e em cada diálogo, seja entre colegas de trabalho ou com clientes, seja nas reuniões internas ou em nossas respostas às transformações do mercado e aos momentos de adversidade.

Desejamos que cada pessoa sinta orgulho de ser quem é e que sinta ainda mais orgulho de fazer parte da nossa história.

A essência de "ser quem você é" nos guia, inspirando a construção diária de um ambiente livre, que celebra e valoriza as singularidades. Sabemos que cada pessoa traz consigo uma perspectiva única e valiosa. O que nos une é a inteligência, a energia e a integridade – virtudes que podem e devem ser cultivadas em qualquer pessoa.

Nos dedicaremos todos os dias para garantir que nossas práticas, nossa cultura e nosso ambiente estejam sempre orientados pela inclusão, acessibilidade e respeito.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Queremos gerar impacto para nosso(a) cliente, quando enxergamos a melhoria que causamos na vida dele(a), é que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

O nosso verde é plural e sempre acolherá todas as pessoas!

Nossa missão é conquistar novos clientes de forma ativa e consultiva através do canal telefônico. Para isso, fazemos um atendimento personalizado com o objetivo de entregar as melhores experiências para o cliente. O time de Outbound está em expansão com o desafio de aumentar a base de clientes através da oferta dos nossos produtos de adquirência.

Como é ser um(a) Analista Comercial de Inside Sales no time de Outbound:

Através do conhecimento sobre o nosso negócio e nossos produtos, você irá realizar as vendas ativas por meio de uma ferramenta de discagem automática.

Você será responsável por realizar vendas ativas aplicando nosso processo de venda, diagnosticando as demandas do cliente, conectando as necessidades dele com as nossas soluções financeiras e com foco em um atendimento de excelência!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Atender as ligações realizadas pela discagem automática;
  • Diagnosticar a necessidade do(a) cliente e conectar nossas soluções para o fechamento da venda;
  • Ter uma boa organização dos clientes em negociação, se certificando de fazer follow-up;
  • Gerar proposta no sistema e certificar que está entregando a melhor proposta ao cliente, acompanhando até o fechamento;
  • Acompanhar seus resultados e do time através de dashboards e reuniões.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Experiência prévia com vendas ativas via telefone (no mínimo 1 ano);
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas;
  • Ensino superior (cursando ou concluído);
  • Habilidades de negociação e influência;
  • Boa oratória e escrita;
  • Capacidade de priorização e de lidar com múltiplas tarefas;
  • Habilidade com ferramentas de CRM (ex: Salesforce);
  • Estar sempre em busca de novas atualizações sobre produtos e ofertas da companhia.

O que aumenta suas chances:

  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas;
  • Capacidade analítica ( ex.: Leitura de Dashboard);
  • Habilidades com gerenciamento de processos;
  • Facilidade com atendimento ao telefone.

Jornada de Trabalho:

  • CLT: 8 horas diárias + 1h de intervalo | Com horário de 09h às 18h | Escala: 5x2 (segunda a sexta) com eventuais escalas aos sábados (opcional).

Modelo e Local de trabalho:

  • Presencial | Cinelândia - Rio de Janeiro/ RJ.
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Virtual Verde disponível 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, de forma rápida e prática
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação - Sodexo
  • Auxílio Creche - para crianças até 5 anos e 11 meses
  • Vale Transporte ou Auxílio Combustível
  • Salário Fixo e Variável + Bônus trimestral (quando preenchidos os requisitos)
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com acesso a diversos livros, podcasts, treinamentos e vídeo aulas visando o autodesenvolvimento (Studa e Biblioteca StoneCo)

Novos Benefícios - Em breve, teremos benefícios exclusivos para pessoas com deficiência.

Etapas do Processo Seletivo:

  • Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco realizando seu cadastro e alguns testes.. Fique tranquilo(a), nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve. Boa sorte!
  • Questionário de Vida: Este é o momento de te conhecermos! Você deverá preencher um questionário com o objetivo de apresentar sua trajetória, hobbies, motivações e sonhos.
  • Entrevistas com o time de People: Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.
  • Entrevista com a Liderança: Nesta etapa vamos nos aprofundar nas suas hard skills com o objetivo de avaliar habilidades e competências específicas para a vaga. Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança.
  • Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  • Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

E aí? Curtiu? Então, não deixa de se inscrever e #VemSerStone

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

The role of an Engineering Manager at Canonical

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, while at the same time staying aware that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked.

You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses, in this case popular open‑source machine learning tools like Kubeflow, MLFlow, and Feast.

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programmes to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

HPC Engineer Role

HPC is an important and technically challenging compute domain, with specialised tooling and a very high expectation of precision, efficiency and automation. This role is for a software engineer to join our HPC team to deliver an outstanding HPC experience – from bare metal to public cloud – as part of the broader Ubuntu platform. We are looking for a range of skills and experience, and will work on everything from the kernel to Debian packaging, but the heart of our effort will be Python software development for automation of key software in the HPC sphere. Our focus is on delivering a world class experience for the operation of the HPC cluster itself. You will be part of the team that delivers charms that deploy and manage the HPC cluster and provide HPC software packages.

To succeed in this application you must be outstanding at maths and sciences, have built high quality software, have learned about open source ideally by working on it directly, and be looking for an engineering role with a company that makes mission‑critical products for the global market. You should also be familiar with the open source environment, and want to build products in partnership with a community. Ideally, you should have some experience of high performance computing environments and a desire to unlock HPC for the world.

For this role you must have experience with Python. Experience in HPC environments is a strong advantage. Familiarity with HPC hardware and software is also a strong advantage – delivering great experiences with Infiniband, RDMA, CUDA, MPI, Slurm, Lustre, Singularity and related technologies will be central to this team’s work. It will also be advantageous to have experience with Docker image design and operations, and public cloud image design and operations.

title: Embedded Linux Consultant - Japan
description:
Overview

Job Description Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

Canonical is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an Embedded Linux Field Engineer for Devices/IoT to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as Consumer Electronics. We are looking for candidates who are accomplished Linux plumbers. If you are someone passionate about Linux, who knows the plumbing of the OS inside and out, who is proficient with distribution packaging, software design, system debugging, and bringing customer's ideas to life, then please keep on reading – this may be a uniquely exciting opportunity for you.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity and footprint.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also dedicated team players that take pride in team and company wins.

We often say that our field engineers have the hardest job at Canonical because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.

Location: This role will be based remotely in Japan (preferably in Tokyo or Osaka area).

What your day will look like

  • Engage customers during presales to gather requirements and explain our technology
  • Elaborate solutions to be proposed to prospective clients
  • Participate to the delivery of select projects related to Embedded Linux
  • Convey market requirements to key stakeholders in our organization, and sometimes participate to the development or refining of generic solutions to unlock market potential
  • Be both a customer advocate and a trusted advisor to Canonical

What we are looking for in you

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Solid embedded Linux experience (Yocto, Buildroot...) or RTOS
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Professional written and spoken English in addition to the local language
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • Result-oriented, ability to multi-task
  • A personal drive to meet commitments
  • An humble learner and quick study
  • Albeit many projects can be done remotely, the successful candidate will be willing to travel up to 30% of the time for customer meetings, company events, and conferences
  • For positions in Japan and Korea, the successful candidates will also be able to speak and write the local language at a professional level.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with customer engagements a plus, but not a requirement

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Senior Software Engineer - MAAS
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

The Canonical MAAS team is responsible for delivering our Metal As A Service hyperscale provisioning technology. Ubuntu strives to be the most scalable, cloud ready server distribution and MAAS is our platform to get it there. MAAS is a rapidly evolving software stack written in Python and Go, and we are looking for experienced software engineers who understand performance at scale, networking, storage and usability.

Applicants should be passionate about the future of Ubuntu and be able to show technical leadership with a globally distributed team of engineers who share that passion. This position requires international travel several times a year.

This role entails

  • Develop MAAS core components and features to make MAAS the #1 bare metal cloud system.
  • Shape the architecture of MAAS to make it simpler, faster and easier to use.
  • Collaborate with other teams to ensure MAAS works well with other tools and is released on time.
  • Contribute your improvements to our continuous integration environment, tests and practices, to maintain fast feedback and good test coverage.
  • Contribute to documentation of current and existing features, making it world‑class resource for Data Centre operators and users.
  • Provide technical communication and collaboration with other teams where appropriate.
  • Take personal ownership of problems and drive them to solutions.
  • Travel internationally a few times a year to meet and collaborate with you and other teams.

What we are looking for in you

  • Passionate about open source software, Linux, and Data Centre automation
  • Solid track record of professional software development experience in Python, Go for back‑end roles, or TypeScript, React for front‑end roles.
  • Capacity to learn quickly about new systems and techniques
  • Excellent logic, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills
  • Strong English language communication skills - both written and verbal
  • Experience with Linux server technologies, including but not limited to Virtualization (KVM), Containers (LXC), etc.
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • Knowledge of network technologies, including PXE, DHCP, TFTP, DNS, NTP
  • Some experience with Baseboard Management Controllers and Protocols (Redfish, IPMI, AMT and others)
  • Strong experience with networking, storage technologies and Cloud hosting and infrastructure.
  • Ideally, experience of large‑scale physical server provisioning and automation, including rapid deployment, configuration, management and service orchestration.
  • Familiarity with some of the open source development tools and methodologies used in creation of several Ubuntu projects (MAAS, Juju, Ubuntu Server, LXD, Ubuntu Core), such as Launchpad, Debian packaging tools (APT, dpkg) and snapcraft.
  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and preferably university.
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Qualifications

  • 5 years of experience in R&D.

  • Ability to provide guidance and mentoring to more junior engineers as needed.

  • Knowledge in power systems demands (Batteries / Recharge / Power management / Passivation / Ramp up / Shut down).

title: Regulatory Affairs (Pharma) Expert
description:
Overview

At Fresenius Medical Care, we are the global leader in kidney care, committed to improving the lives of patients with chronic kidney disease. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, innovative products, services, and care across the entire healthcare journey. Guided by our vision—“Creating a future worth living. For patients. Worldwide. Every day.”—we work with purpose and compassion, supported by a global team of over 125,000 employees.

Within our Care Enablement segment, we develop and provide life-sustaining medical products, digital health solutions, and therapies that empower clinical teams and improve patient outcomes. Our FME Reignite strategy drives transformation through innovation, efficiency, and sustainable growth.

Our Values

Our values guide how we work:

  • We Care for our patients, each other, and our communities
  • We Connect across teams and borders to deliver excellence together
  • We Commit to doing things the right way— growing with purpose and leading kidney care with integrity and innovation

Responsibilities

Your Responsibilities:

  • Lead global regulatory strategy and submissions across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Plan, author, and review eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Represent Regulatory Affairs on cross-functional teams, providing guidance on regional requirements and development pathways
  • Provide strategic input on CMC, clinical, and nonclinical documentation for global compliance
  • Coordinate electronic submissions with Regulatory Operations using Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart, and global gateways (FDA ESG, CESP, BfArM, Health Canada, ANVISA)
  • Monitor global regulations and communicate key changes to stakeholders
  • Prepare regulatory correspondence, briefing packages, and materials for health authority meetings
  • Manage post-approval commitments, renewals, and lifecycle activities
  • Review labeling, advertising, and promotional materials for regulatory compliance
  • Maintain relationships with health authorities and industry peers
  • Partner with Quality, Clinical, Nonclinical, and Manufacturing to align regulatory documentation
  • Improve regulatory processes and support audits, inspections, and other regulatory projects

Your Profile

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, or related field required; advanced degree (M.S., Ph.D., Pharm.D.) preferred
  • RAC certification or equivalent highly desirable; ongoing professional development in global regulatory strategy is a plus
  • 8–10 years of global regulatory affairs experience in drug development and lifecycle management across U.S., EU, Canada, LATAM, and APAC
  • Strong hands-on experience with global eCTD submissions (IND, NDA, ANDA, MAA, variations, renewals, supplements)
  • Proven success in global registration strategy and interactions with FDA, EMA, Health Canada, ANVISA, NMPA, and other authorities
  • Deep knowledge of ICH guidelines, regional regulations, and global submission standards
  • Proficiency with regulatory information/publishing systems (e.g., Veeva Vault RIM, RIMSmart) and electronic gateways
  • Broad understanding of CMC, clinical, and nonclinical regulatory requirements
  • Strong project management, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work independently in a global matrix, handle multiple complex projects, and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements

Our Offer for you

There is a lot you can discover at Fresenius Medical Care, regardless in which field you are an expert and how much experience you have - all dedicated to your professional journey.

  • Whether in front of or behind the scenes - you are helping to make ever better medicine available to more and more people around the world
  • Individual opportunities for self-determined career planning and professional development
  • A corporate culture in which there is enough room for innovative thinking - to find the best solution together, not the quickest one
  • A large number of committed people with a wide range of skills, talents and experience
  • The benefits of a successful global corporation with the collegial culture of a medium-sized company

title: Quality Control Inspector
description:
About the Role


The Service Provider will be providing QC services at WAG (Water Alternate Gas) manifolds worksite based in Rio, Brazil with frequent travel within to Distrito Industrial – Vespasiano/MG Brasil. You will be responsible to ensure that Contractor (CTR) supplies WAG Manifold and Foundations on-time as per the clients HSE policies and with satisfactory & required level of quality.


The Service Provider will liaise with CPY Subsea HSE Lead, CPY Quality Lead, CPY Materials & Welding Lead and CPY Delivery Lead.



HSE and Compliance



  • Fully comply with site security, health and safety instructions, stay vigilant and maintain continuous awareness of hazards and surroundings.

  • Will be accountable for demonstrating, individually, an exemplary behaviour regarding HSE rules & requirements, including trainings, and enforcing HSE execution decisions/directions taken by CPY Subsea HSE Lead.

  • Report any issue/anomalies (using system in place in the facility) and to make use of TOTAL STOP WORK policy as necessary.

  • Ensure that risk assessments are performed as and when necessary, that management of change is adhered to and that tool-box talks are conducted efficiently.

  • Adopt and demonstrate exemplary behaviour regarding Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy and promote the re-enforcement of the Anti-Corruption Program.


WORK TASKS


The Service holder will be responsible to control that the work performed by CTR and sub-CTR is in line with CPY and Project Specifications for WAG Manifolds and Foundations in terms of Quality.


For all these tasks, the incumbent will be requested:



  • To conduct thorough inspections of welds and welding processes to ensure compliance with applicable WPS/PQR, codes, standards, and specifications, have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have ability to conduct welding inspection before, during and after as per ISO 3834-2 requirements

  • To have extensive inspection knowledge and experience (min 10 years) in CRA materials such as Super duplex (Pipe/Forging and HIPPED), Inconel 625 and LAS (F22)

  • To have excellent inspection experience in buttering, overlay and girth welding of Inconel 625 and Alloy 59 consumables

  • To utilize advanced inspection techniques including visual, ultrasonic, Phase Array Ultrasonic Testing (PAUT), magnetic particle, Liquid penetrant Inspection and radiographic testing to assess weld quality as per ASME/DNV code requirements

  • To have ability to interpret welding procedure specifications (WPS) and procedure qualification records (PQR) to validate conformance at site during production

  • To have the ability to perform inspection on incoming production materials against requirements and mill certificates

  • To participate in root cause analysis for welding defects and development of corrective action plans in collaboration with project welding engineer and site production teams

  • To identify and raise subsequent comments highlight deviations, unacceptable or unjustified quality issues related but not limited to Welding that could affect SPS equipment during fabrication, installation, and production at site

  • To prepare detailed inspection reports and documentation for compliance on weekly basis

  • To collaborate with Company Site Rep and CPY material engineer on any welding/NDT/material issues at site

  • To stop the work in case of non-conformity and re-assess the situation before resuming To discuss with contractor/sub-contractors in case of issues/unconformity during the control program, to look for acceptable solutions in order not to penalize the delivery schedule but still fulfilling the quality standards set by the contract

  • To ensure that unconformities are driven towards closure in a timely manner (i.e. without impacting the delivery schedule)

  • To follow up site welding activities and provide feedback to project team

  • To participate to COMPANY and contractor audits and follow up closure of identified issues


About You


You are a highly experienced welding and quality professional with a strong background in subsea structures and WAG manifolds. You bring more than 15 years of hands-on experience in welding inspection, with deep technical knowledge of welding processes, materials, and offshore fabrication requirements.


You hold a recognized Welding Inspector certification such as CSWIP 3.1 or 3.2 (or equivalent) and are certified to Level 3 in multiple Non-Destructive Testing methods, including Ultrasonic Testing (UT/PAUT), Radiography (RT), and Dye Penetrant Inspection (DPI).


You are confident in interpreting complex engineering drawings, technical specifications, and welding documentation, and you are known for your strong analytical skills and ability to investigate root causes and resolve challenging quality issues in fast-paced project environments.


You communicate clearly and professionally in English, with additional language skills in Portuguese or French considered an advantage.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy.

Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location

Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing.

Leadership and Accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.

Responsibilities

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Quem somos

A São Carlos Saúde Oncológica é um hospital que construiu, ao longo das últimas cinco décadas, uma trajetória em saúde oncológica no Rio de Janeiro, com o objetivo de oferecer um tratamento oncológico próximo e personalizado. Desde a sua fundação, em 1967, passando por cada geração, até os dias atuais, todos procuram a São Carlos Saúde Oncológica com um único objetivo: o câncer. Nós já nascemos para cuidar do paciente oncológico.

Para isso, acreditamos no trabalho em equipe e investimos na composição de uma estrutura interdisciplinar em que o paciente e seus familiares encontram tudo o que precisam em um só lugar, 24h por dia. É o nosso conceito One Stop Care, que reúne Internação, Pronto Atendimento 24h, Quimioterapia, Radioterapia, bem como toda a parte de Medicina Nuclear (diagnóstica e terapêutica), Exames e Consultas com especialistas das mais diferentes áreas - todos voltados para a Oncologia.

Para nós, a vida vale muito. E por esse motivo, buscamos ressignificar o câncer e seu efeito nas vidas pessoas. Aqui, vamos além da doença e do tratamento em si. Encaramos o câncer de frente, como uma causa que precisa ser abordada sem tabu, sem medo e com muita coragem.

title: Senior Project Manager Travel
description:
Senior Project Manager Travel

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Senior Travel Project Manager oversees strategic travel planning, commercial management, and operations within the complex environment of a multi-stakeholder tournament.

This position plays a key role in ensuring the success of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027 by organizing and managing travel projects that provide safe, efficient, and dependable transportation for everyone involved in the event.

Responsible for turning FWWC27 event requirements into practical travel plans, the Senior Travel Project Manager works under tight deadlines and in collaboration with various stakeholders.

Collaboration, accountability, and operational excellence are central to this role, which involves close coordination with the FIFA Global Travel team, other functional departments, host country authorities, and selected travel service providers.

The Senior Travel Project Manager ensures all projects adhere to company policies, service standards, sustainability commitments, and risk management practices. They also anticipate dependencies, address operational risks, and drive progress on key milestones.

By using structured project management methods and competency standards, this role supports consistent outcomes, builds stakeholder trust, and delivers an exceptional tournament experience. Additionally, it contributes to knowledge sharing, ongoing improvement, and planning for future events.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic, Commercial & Financial Oversight

  • Ownership of tournament travel budget planning, cost benchmarking, and financial risk mitigation
  • Market benchmarking of airline/charter pricing to ensure competitiveness (RFP)
  • Identification, analysis, and escalation of pricing inconsistencies, capacity constraints, and commercial misalignments with airline and travel partners
  • Contribution to the development of travel rate cards, pricing frameworks, and commercial guidelines

Scenario Planning & Risk Management

  • Development of contingency plans for high level client groups
  • Proactive identification and mitigation of operational risk
  • Decision-making under high time pressure to ensure continuity of tournament operations while maintaining service levels and cost control

Senior Stakeholder & Executive Interface

  • Acting as an advisory interface between FIFA Functional Areas, External Stakeholders, Suppliers, Host Country Authorities, and FIFA/FWWC27 Senior leadership
  • Preparation of executive-level briefings, recommendations, and decision papers related to travel strategy, pricing, and operational readiness
  • Support to FIFA Partnerships in managing expectations with commercial partners in high-demand or capacity-constrained environments

Data, Systems & Process Governance

  • Oversight of travel-related data accuracy, reporting structures, and decision-support tools used throughout the tournament lifecycle
  • Ensuring transparency, traceability, and auditability of travel decisions, supplier selections, and cost structures
  • Contribution to the continuous improvement of FIFA travel handbooks, templates, operational playbooks, and systems

Tournament Scale & Complexity Management

  • End-to-end coordination of high-volume, multi-city charter and scheduled flight operations during tournament time
  • Ensuring consistent service delivery across multiple client groups (Teams, Delegates, Guests, VIPs, Workforce, FIFA/FWWC27 stakeholders)

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Completed (business) travel agency education or business education with training in the travel industry
  • Further education in tourism, event or general management

Experience

  • At least 5 years of experience in the business travel industry (travel, accommodation and ground transportation)
  • Excellent skills in GDS, preferably GDS Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules are a must
  • At least 2 years of experience in project and event management

Skills & Competencies

  • Experience in budgeting and accounting
  • Good negotiation skills
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese, additional languages beneficial
  • Practical commercial experience, distinguished geographical knowledge
  • Systemic and analytical thinking
  • Autonomy and sense of responsibility
  • Practical and process-oriented working profile with quality and efficiency
  • Intercultural competencies, Flexibility, adapting working processes to different cultures
  • Strong team player
  • Clear communication skills in different languages
  • Friendly and diplomatic behaviour to customers, team members and working colleagues
  • Capability to promote knowledge transfer with other team members
  • Service-oriented working style
  • Taking initiative and working proactively
  • Speedy delivery of short-term orders, respecting deadlines
  • Vision to predict potential problematical scenarios and anticipate solutions
  • Creativity to solve unforeseen issues
  • Solution-oriented operation

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Strong GDS skills, with preference for Amadeus/ticketing and fare rules required
